summary: relativity-pdfjs-dist preinstall exfiltrates host identity to Burp Collaborator OOB endpoint
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs curl to POST the contents of /etc/hostname to a subdomain of oastify.com (Burp Collaborator out-of-band infrastructure), with the installer's hostname embedded in the destination subdomain. This fires automatically on npm install. The package name resembles Mozilla's pdfjs-dist but the tarball ships only package.json with no library code (the declared main index.js is absent), so the sole effect of installing this package is the outbound beacon carrying host identity to attacker-controlled infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
